title: API from OpenAPI / Swagger
description: Paste the link to your API's Swagger/OpenAPI document and a test is generated for every endpoint.
needs: The link to the OpenAPI / Swagger document (usually ends in openapi.json, swagger.json or v3/api-docs)

target.label: OpenAPI / Swagger document link
target.help: Ask a developer for it if you are unsure. It is a link that shows a long block of JSON or YAML.

target.label: API address override
target.help: Only if the real API lives at a different address than the document says (for example a staging server).

target.label: How does the API check who you are?
target.help: Leave on 'none' for a public API. Passwords and tokens are picked from saved secrets, never typed.

target.label: API key (saved secret)
target.help: Reference only: ${secret:NAME} or ${env:NAME}. The document says where the key is sent.

details.label: Also check that bad requests are rejected
details.help: Adds 'no login is refused' and 'empty body is refused' checks for each endpoint.

details.label: Fail responses slower than (ms)
details.help: Leave empty for no time limit.
